mkdir -p "$HOME/.zed_antigravity" cd "$HOME/.zed_antigravity"
# Set up venv and install deps on first run if [ ! -d "venv" ]; then python3 -m venv venv venv/bin/pip install --quiet fastapi uvicorn google-antigravity python-dotenv fi
# Always use the bundled server.py (copied during install) exec venv/bin/python server.py
